## Summary

Describe the change and why it is useful.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] Test improvement
- [ ] New learning example
- [ ] Build or CI maintenance

## Verification

- [ ] I ran `mvn verify` for Java changes.
- [ ] I updated or added tests where behaviour changed.
- [ ] I checked links, code snippets, and formatting for documentation changes.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] This PR contains no passwords, tokens, connection strings, private URLs, or customer data.
- [ ] The change remains compatible with the repository's Java 8 baseline, or the upgrade impact is documented.
